brand_identity.positioning: Awwwards-level web design, brand systems, domains, hosting & digital infrastructure agency with a dark, cinematic aesthetic.
brand_identity.emotional_archetype: LUXURY & RETRO-FUTURIST EDITORIAL (Cinematic Dark, Gold Spark, Crimson Accent)
brand_identity.logo_signature: Black rounded-square container, white serif wordmark, crimson red rounded-square icon containing a white circle, gold/yellow accent underline.

color_system.theme_mode: Dark Cinematic (Fixed Dark Base with High-Contrast Accents)
rules: NEVER use pure black #000000; always tint with subtle deep violet/indigo tone (#08080B).
Red accent (#C8322B) is reserved for primary focal points, live status indicators, badge highlights, and interactive triggers.
Gold accent (#D4AF37) is reserved for underlines, key metric values, manifesto chapter numbers, and award tags.
Text contrast must strictly maintain WCAG AA standard against dark surfaces.

typography.heading_font: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, or serif display (loaded via Google Fonts @import in index.css)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Outfit, or Inter (sans-serif body text)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code (for service specs & manifesto counters)

scale_hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
scale_hierarchy.h2_section: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight

layout_and_spacing.strategy: The Swiss Grid with Bento Modernity & Asymmetric Tension

grid_modes.hero_layout: Asymmetric 12-column split with full kinetic typography reveal, interactive canvas sphere on right, and live status pill.
grid_modes.manifesto_grid: 3-column staggered editorial grid with giant numbered gold counters (01, 02, 03...), vertical borders, and rich description blocks.
grid_modes.portfolio_bento: Tetris Grid layout combining widescreen 8-col hero project cards with 4-col tall showcases and hover video/image zoom previews.
grid_modes.services_grid: 4-column high-density bento grid featuring website deployment, logo identity, banner art, custom domains, and managed hosting.

layout_and_spacing.padding_rules: Generous spacing philosophy: py-20 to py-32 for major page sections. Card containers must have internal padding p-6 to p-8 to avoid edge collision.

signature_features.on_load_text_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal animation using Framer Motion with cubic-bezier ease out.
signature_features.3d_lunar_hero: Interactive WebGL canvas / Three.js glowing lunar sphere with floating gold & red particles, responding to mouse position.
signature_features.slow_editorial_marquee: Continuous low-speed drifting ticker featuring services, award honors, and partner logos with subtle thin top/bottom borders.
signature_features.numbered_manifesto: Editorial section with chapters 01, 02, 03 detailing Lunar Design's philosophy (Precision, Immersion, Infrastructure).
signature_features.interactive_enquiry_system: Multi-step or rich single-page enquiry form with interactive service chip selectors, budget slider, and submission modal/toast with persistent state.
signature_features.portfolio_case_modal: Full overlay modal showing case study metrics, live demo link, technical tech stack tags, and client quotes.
signature_features.social_integration: Direct Instagram feed/link button with custom kinetic magnetic hover effect.

testing_and_attributes.rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, links, tabs, cards, and modal triggers MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Google Fonts for 'Playfair Display' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' are imported in frontend/src/index.css.
Implement smooth scrolling or Lenis wrapper behavior for continuous silky scroll feel.
Ensure all components use JS/JSX syntax as per project configuration.
Create an interactive Canvas or Framer-Motion animated sphere component for the hero section to deliver the 'lunar' aesthetic.
Verify every single button and form element has its designated data-testid attribute.
Ensure the enquiry form is completely functional with toast alerts upon submission.
